subject: general
question: The terms = Dribbling, passing, shooting are associated with which sport?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Basketball**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Basketball**:-

 
 
• It is a team sport in which two teams of five players each try to score points by throwing a ball through a hoop that is 10 feet (3.05 m) high and attached to a backboard.
 
• The game is played on a rectangular court with a basket at each end.
 
• **The terms "Dribbling", "passing", and "shooting" are associated with the sport of basketball.**
 
 
• **Dribbling **is the act of bouncing the ball continuously with one hand while moving around the court.
 
• **Passing** is the act of throwing the ball to a teammate.
 
• **Shooting **is the act of throwing the ball at the basket in an attempt to score points.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Badminton** is a racquet sport where players hit a shuttlecock over a net.
 
• **Shooting **is a sport where players use ranged weapons to hit targets.
 
• **Cricket** is a bat-and-ball game where players try to score runs by hitting a ball with a bat and running between the wickets.
